paite: Jeroboam kum sawm-le-giat avaihawm kum in Judahte tung ah Abijah in vai ahawm pan hi.
heading: Jeroboam Toh Abijah Kidouna / (1 Kum 15.1-8)
english: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.

paite: Jerusalem ah kum thum vai ahawm a, anu min Mikaiah, Gibeah mi Uriel tanu ahi. Huan Abijah leh Jeroboam bel akidou uhi.
english: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

paite: Abijah in sepaih kidoumi, mihangsan telkhiak nuaili toh ava sual a, Jeroboam mihat hangsan telkhiak nuaigiat kiphalh in ana dou uhi.
english: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.

paite: Abijah bel Ephraim tanggam a om Zemariam tang tung ah adingh a, "Aw Jeroboam, Israelte tengteng toh na ngaikhia un;
english: Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, “Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel:

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in Israel gam David leh atate kiang a chi a thukhun in tangtawn a ding in apia chih thei dia kilawm mahmah hilou na hi uh maw?
english: Ought you not to know that Yahweh, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

paite: Himahleh Nebat tapa Jeroboam, David tapa Solomon sikha apu tung ah ahong hel maimah hi.
english: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.

paite: Rehoboam anaupang lai a, alungsim anem lai a, amaute ana nan theih louh lai in Solomon tapa Rehoboam kalh in mithulim lou Belial tate akikaikhawm uhi.
english: Worthless men were gathered to him, wicked fellows who strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender hearted, and could not withstand them.

paite: "David tapa lak ah TOUPA gam dou theih na kigingta kei ua: tamkuam leng hi ua, Jeroboam in pathiante ding a nou ahon bawlsak dangka-eng bawngnou limte leng na kiang uah a-om lai hi.
english: “Now you intend to withstand the kingdom of Yahweh in the hand of the sons of David. You are a great multitude, and the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods are with you.

paite: TOUPA siampu, Aaron tapate leh Levite delhkhia in, gamdang mite hihdan bang in siampu na kibawl uh ahi kei maw? Huchi in bawngtuai leh belam sagih a hong kilan peuhmahte pathian hiloupite siampu ahi thei zel mawk uhi.
english: Haven’t you driven out the priests of Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made priests for yourselves according to the ways of the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of those who are no gods.

paite: "Himahleh kou zaw, ka Pathian uh TOUPA ahi a, amah ka lehngatsan kei ua: TOUPA a dia nasemmi amau nna chiat sem Aaron tapa siampute leh Levite ka nei uhi.
english: “But as for us, Yahweh is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work.

paite: Ni teng leh zan teng in TOUPA a ding in halmang thillatte, gimlimte ahal zel uh, tanghou siah leng dohkan siangthou ah akoih kichian gige uhi. Nitaklam teng a hal ding in dangka-eng khawnvak koihna akhawnvak toh; kou zaw TOUPA ka Pathian uh thupiak ka zui gige ua, nou bel amah na lehngatsan uhi.
english: They burn to Yahweh every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table, and care for the gold lamp stand with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of Yahweh our God, but you have forsaken him.

paite: Ngai dih ua, Pathian ka ma uh pi in ka kiang uah a-om a, asiampute leng apengkul ua nou hon noh ding a mut ding in a-om uhi. Aw, Israel suante aw TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian zaw dou mahmah kei un, na lamzang kei hial ding uh," achi hi.
english: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, don’t fight against Yahweh, the God of your fathers; for you will not prosper.”

paite: Himahleh Jeroboam in anunglam uah aguktansak a: huchi in Judahte malam ah a-om ua, guktan mite anunglam uah a-om uh.
english: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambush was behind them.

paite: Judahte alehngat uleh anunglam uh leh amalam uah gal a-omta a, TOUPA asam ua, siampute'n pengkul amut uhi.
english: When Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried to Yahweh, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

paite: Huchi in Judahte akikou zuazua ua; huchi a Judahte akikou zuazua ualeh hichi ahong hi a, Abijah leh Judahte ma ah TOUPA'N Jeroboam leh Israelte tengteng avuallelsakta hi.
english: Then the men of Judah gave a shout. As the men of Judah shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

paite: Israel suante Judahte ma ah ataikek ua, Pathian in akhut uah apeta hi.
english: The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.

paite: Huchi in Abijah leh aheute'n amau athat ua: Israel mitel ngen nuainga athat uhi.
english: Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter, so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain.

paite: Huai tung in Israel suante vuallelhdan huchibang ahi, Judah suante'n TOUPA apipute uh Pathian amuan ziak un azouta uhi.
english: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

paite: Huan Abijah in Jeroboam adelh a, akhuate alaksak a, Bethel akhotate toh, Jeshanah akhotate toh, Ephron akhotate toh.
english: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him: Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.

paite: Abijah vaihawm lai nite in Jeroboam in dinkhiak zohna anei nawn kei; TOUPA'N agawt a, asita hi.
english: Jeroboam didn’t recover strength again in the days of Abijah. Yahweh struck him, and he died.

paite: Abijah bel ahat deuhdeuh a, zi sawm-le-li anei a, tapa sawmnih-le-nih leh tanu sawm-le-guk anei hi.
english: But Abijah grew mighty and took for himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

paite: Abijah tanchin dangte leh a-omdante, athugente zawlnei Iddo hilhchetna bu ah gelh in a-om hi.
english: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.
